info.name: Microsoft 365 integration
info.summary: Two-way sync of Microsoft 365 calendars, contacts and To Do tasks
info.description:
Keeps Microsoft 365 (Exchange Online) calendars, contacts and Microsoft To Do lists in sync with Nextcloud Calendar, Contacts and Tasks — in both directions, through the Microsoft Graph API.
An administrator registers one Azure application; each user connects their own Microsoft account and chooses which calendars, contact folders and task lists to synchronise. Changes made in Outlook appear in Nextcloud within minutes and vice versa.
**Data sent to Microsoft:** the calendar, contact and task data you choose to synchronise is read from and written to Microsoft Graph (graph.microsoft.com) on your behalf. Nothing else leaves your server.
info.author: Malte Zilinski
